scientific_integrity: A written all-parameter integral homotopy proof is given by exact deletion/link decompositions and nullhomotopic cone maps. Finite independent enumeration verifies cases but is not a general proof. Same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two forward span-two shortcuts on a coherently oriented cycle, n>=6. No equivariant, arbitrary-chord, or three-shortcut assertions. Residual bibliographic priority risk.
title: Adjacency-sensitive sphere wedges from two forward shortcuts in a directed cycle
